snippet.title: The New KH2FM Experience
snippet.description:
The full release of KH2FM Free Flow Virtuoso Improvements Implementation (FFVII) on PCSX2.
Installation Guide (includes downloads): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VgwK0OWn5vE

Music Tool Optional Features Guide if you want to make your own KH2FM playlists: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TYo_v6kPm9k

KH2FMFFVII OST: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-w6lGLINa7T4cIS6lqRh2c04XJOAP6c-

*********MEDIA*********
Discord: https://discord.gg/W5AP2wMPPw

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Xaddgx

List of all contributors and their media: https://pastebin.com/TfPx7xTR

Merch store to support the family: https://debugthreads.com/en-usd

Follow me here for the occasional short clips: https://www.tiktok.com/@xaddgx

*********MUSIC*********
1. KH2 - Sora (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

2. KH2 - Working Together (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

3. KH2FM - The 13th Reflection (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

4. KH3 - Eye of the Storm (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

5. Symphonic Fantasies ~ Encore (Final Boss Suite) [Destati Loop]

6. KH2 - Organization XIII (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

7. KH 358/2 Days - Another Side, Another Story (Battle Ver.) (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

8. KH2 - Courage (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

9. KH2FM - Deep Anxiety (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

10. KH2 - A Fight to the Death (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

11. KH 1.5/Coded - Night of Fate (Dual Mix)

12. Lost Kingdoms II - Card Shop (Nanashima's KH2FMFFVII Remix)

(Everything else is tool audio and descriptions are limited to 5K characters.)

**********PLAYLISTS**********
KH2FMFFVII Moveset Guides: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-w6lGLINa7TWPhu0jDDzORz16eqoBlGn
Project Aqua: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-w6lGLINa7RWeFCC_FjTG0kM_v-1CvbJ
Vanitas: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-w6lGLINa7QlRt186zcULMP3BUK9SzgG
KH2FM Modding Tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-w6lGLINa7TDzAlTHhb4qn5WvctxU_Vc

*********DESCRIPTION*********
This is the final entry video for the FFVII Mod for Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix.

The pitch for this mod:
Better Sora, better boss fights, mostly vanilla experience built in if you don't want to play Challenge Mode, better graphical fidelity for emulator version by far, substantial quality of life improvements, replay value, many internal bug fixes from vanilla, all Drive Forms have unique playstyles that all actually work, 100+ costumes with choice, many more memorable moments, cutscene support, entirely customizable and remade OST, optional sandbox mode, the most player choice of all time, rewarding mastery, accessibility, fun, and entirely replacing the vanilla version by virtue of being that much more fun are all of the included goals.
